content.bridge_context: Continuing the study of how people in villages manage their own affairs through the Panchayati Raj system.

units.title: The Gram Panchayat
units.explanation: A committee of elected members who take care of the village's needs like roads, water, and schools.
units.dual_language_instruction: Who is the head of a Panchayat called? / पंचायत के मुखिया को क्या कहते हैं?

units.title: Participating in Decisions
units.explanation: The Gram Sabha is where all adult villagers meet to discuss problems and check the work of the Panchayat.
units.dual_language_instruction: Why is it important for everyone to attend village meetings? / गाँव की बैठकों में सभी का शामिल होना क्यों जरूरी है?
